- [USER] User asked for the definition of the phrase "one more pass."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The phrase "one more pass" typically refers to the act of going over something once again in order to check for any errors or make final adjustments.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The phrase can be used in various contexts, such as editing a written document, reviewing a project, or perfecting a skill.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The idea behind "one more pass" is to take one last look or attempt before considering the task complete.
